# Purpose

This notebook evaluates the effects of the qFL-Chr.25 introgression and
processing stage on AFIS fiber-quality measurements.

The primary mixed model evaluates:

- cotton genetic background;
- qFL-Chr.25 status;
- processing stage;
- qFL-Chr.25 × processing-stage interaction;
- background-specific qFL-Chr.25 responses.

The field sample is the repeated-measures experimental unit because each
sample was evaluated at Bale, Opened, Carded, and Sliver stages.

# 5. Prepare factors

```{r prepare-factors}
afis_all <- afis_all |>
  dplyr::mutate(

    field_sample_id = factor(
      field_sample_id
    ),

    genotype = factor(
      genotype
    ),

    background = factor(
      background
    ),

    nil_set = factor(
      nil_set
    ),

    pair_id = interaction(
      background,
      nil_set,
      drop = TRUE,
      lex.order = TRUE
    ),

    qtl_status = factor(
      qtl_status,
      levels = c(
        "Negative",
        "Positive",
        "Parent_Check"
      )
    ),

    field_rep = factor(
      field_rep
    ),

    processing_stage = factor(
      processing_stage,
      levels = c(
        "Bale",
        "Opened",
        "Carded",
        "Sliver"
      ),
      ordered = TRUE
    ),

    trait_label = factor(
      trait_label
    )
  )
```

# 7. Define the primary model dataset

Parents and checks are excluded from formal qTL inference because they do not
form Positive–Negative NIL contrasts.

```{r create-primary-analysis-data}
afis_model_data <- afis_all |>
  dplyr::filter(
    qtl_status %in% c(
      "Negative",
      "Positive"
    )
  ) |>
  droplevels() |>
  dplyr::filter(
    !is.na(value),
    !is.na(field_sample_id),
    !is.na(background),
    !is.na(pair_id),
    !is.na(qtl_status),
    !is.na(field_rep),
    !is.na(processing_stage),
    !is.na(trait_label)
  )

dplyr::glimpse(
  afis_model_data
)
```

# 11. Mixed-model specification

For each AFIS trait, the primary model is:

```text
Trait =
Background × qTL status × Processing stage
+ Field replication
+ random NIL-pair effect
+ random field-sample effect
```

The random field-sample effect accounts for repeated measurements across the
four processing stages.

```{r model-formula}
primary_model_formula <- value ~
  background * qtl_status * processing_stage +
  field_rep +
  (1 | pair_id) +
  (1 | field_sample_id)

primary_model_formula
```

# 12. Model-fitting function

```{r model-fitting-function}
fit_afis_model <- function(
  data,
  trait_name
) {

  trait_data <- data |>
    dplyr::filter(
      as.character(trait_label) ==
        trait_name
    ) |>
    droplevels()

  warnings_detected <- character()

  fitted_model <- tryCatch(

    withCallingHandlers(

      lmerTest::lmer(
        formula = primary_model_formula,
        data = trait_data,
        REML = TRUE,
        na.action = stats::na.omit,
        control = lme4::lmerControl(
          optimizer = "bobyqa",
          optCtrl = list(
            maxfun = 200000
          )
        )
      ),

      warning = function(w) {

        warnings_detected <<- c(
          warnings_detected,
          conditionMessage(w)
        )

        invokeRestart(
          "muffleWarning"
        )
      }
    ),

    error = function(e) {
      structure(
        list(
          message = conditionMessage(e)
        ),
        class = "afis_model_error"
      )
    }
  )

  list(
    trait = trait_name,
    data = trait_data,
    model = fitted_model,
    warnings = unique(
      warnings_detected
    )
  )
}
```


# 14. Model-status audit

```{r model-status-audit}
model_status <- purrr::map_dfr(
  model_results,
  function(result) {

    model_failed <- inherits(
      result$model,
      "afis_model_error"
    )

    tibble::tibble(

      trait_label = result$trait,

      n_observations = nrow(
        result$data
      ),

      n_field_samples =
        dplyr::n_distinct(
          result$data$field_sample_id
        ),

      model_status = if (
        model_failed
      ) {
        "FAILED"
      } else {
        "FITTED"
      },

      singular_fit = if (
        model_failed
      ) {
        NA
      } else {
        lme4::isSingular(
          result$model,
          tol = 1e-4
        )
      },

      warning_message = if (
        length(result$warnings) == 0
      ) {
        NA_character_
      } else {
        paste(
          result$warnings,
          collapse = " | "
        )
      },

      error_message = if (
        model_failed
      ) {
        result$model$message
      } else {
        NA_character_
      }
    )
  }
)

model_status
```

```{r stop-if-all-models-failed}
if (
  all(

) {

    "All AFIS mixed models failed. Review the model-status table."

}
```

# 15. Extract Type III fixed-effect tests

```{r extract-type-three-tests}
extract_anova <- function(result) {

  if (
    inherits(
      result$model,
      "afis_model_error"
    )
  ) {
    return(
      tibble::tibble(
        trait_label = result$trait,
        effect = NA_character_,
        numerator_df = NA_real_,
        denominator_df = NA_real_,
        f_value = NA_real_,
        p_value = NA_real_
      )
    )
  }

  # Use the generic anova() function.
  # The lmerTest method is selected automatically because the model
  # was fitted using lmerTest::lmer().
  anova_object <- stats::anova(
    result$model,
    type = 3,
    ddf = "Satterthwaite"
  )

  anova_table <- anova_object |>
    as.data.frame() |>
    tibble::rownames_to_column(
      var = "effect"
    ) |>
    tibble::as_tibble()

  # Identify the p-value column safely.
  p_column <- grep(
    "^Pr\\(",
    names(anova_table),
    value = TRUE
  )[1]

  if (
    length(p_column) == 0 ||
    is.na(p_column)
  ) {
    stop(
      "The p-value column could not be identified for trait: ",
      result$trait
    )
  }

  tibble::tibble(
    trait_label = result$trait,
    effect = anova_table$effect,
    numerator_df = anova_table[["NumDF"]],
    denominator_df = anova_table[["DenDF"]],
    f_value = anova_table[["F value"]],
    p_value = anova_table[[p_column]]
  )
}

afis_type3_tests <- purrr::map_dfr(
  model_results,
  extract_anova
) |>
  dplyr::group_by(
    effect
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    p_value_fdr = stats::p.adjust(
      p_value,
      method = "BH"
    )
  ) |>
  dplyr::ungroup() |>
  dplyr::arrange(
    effect,
    p_value
  )

afis_type3_tests
```

# 16. Extract variance components

```{r extract-variance-components}
extract_variance_components <- function(
  result
) {

  if (
    inherits(
      result$model,
      "afis_model_error"
    )
  ) {
    return(
      tibble::tibble(
        trait_label = result$trait,
        random_effect = NA_character_,
        variance = NA_real_,
        standard_deviation = NA_real_
      )
    )
  }

  broom.mixed::tidy(
    result$model,
    effects = "ran_pars",
    scales = "sdcor"
  ) |>
    dplyr::transmute(

      trait_label = result$trait,

      random_effect = dplyr::coalesce(
        group,
        term
      ),

      variance = estimate^2,

      standard_deviation = estimate
    )
}

afis_variance_components <- purrr::map_dfr(
  model_results,
  extract_variance_components
)

afis_variance_components
```

# 17. Estimated marginal means

These means average across backgrounds unless background is explicitly
included in the table.

```{r extract-emmeans}
extract_emmeans <- function(
  result
) {

  if (
    inherits(
      result$model,
      "afis_model_error"
    )
  ) {
    return(
      tibble::tibble()
    )
  }

  emmeans::emmeans(
    result$model,
    specs = ~ qtl_status * processing_stage
  ) |>
    as.data.frame() |>
    tibble::as_tibble() |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      trait_label = result$trait,
      .before = 1
    )
}

afis_emmeans <- purrr::map_dfr(
  model_results,
  extract_emmeans
)

afis_emmeans
```

# 18. Positive-minus-Negative contrasts within each stage

A positive estimate means the qFL-Chr.25-positive line had the larger
estimated mean.

```{r qtl-contrasts-within-stage}
extract_qtl_stage_contrasts <- function(
  result
) {

  if (
    inherits(
      result$model,
      "afis_model_error"
    )
  ) {
    return(
      tibble::tibble()
    )
  }

  qtl_emmeans <- emmeans::emmeans(
    result$model,
    specs = ~ qtl_status | processing_stage
  )

  emmeans::contrast(
    qtl_emmeans,
    method = list(
      "Positive - Negative" = c(
        -1,
        1
      )
    ),
    by = "processing_stage",
    adjust = "none"
  ) |>
    as.data.frame() |>
    tibble::as_tibble() |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      trait_label = result$trait,
      .before = 1
    )
}

afis_qtl_stage_contrasts <- purrr::map_dfr(
  model_results,
  extract_qtl_stage_contrasts
) |>
  dplyr::group_by(
    processing_stage
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    p_value_fdr = stats::p.adjust(
      p.value,
      method = "BH"
    )
  ) |>
  dplyr::ungroup()

afis_qtl_stage_contrasts
```

# 19. Background-specific Positive-minus-Negative contrasts

```{r background-specific-contrasts}
extract_background_stage_contrasts <- function(
  result
) {

  if (
    inherits(
      result$model,
      "afis_model_error"
    )
  ) {
    return(
      tibble::tibble()
    )
  }

  background_emmeans <- emmeans::emmeans(
    result$model,
    specs =
      ~ qtl_status |
        background * processing_stage
  )

  emmeans::contrast(
    background_emmeans,
    method = list(
      "Positive - Negative" = c(
        -1,
        1
      )
    ),
    by = c(
      "background",
      "processing_stage"
    ),
    adjust = "none"
  ) |>
    as.data.frame() |>
    tibble::as_tibble() |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      trait_label = result$trait,
      .before = 1
    )
}

afis_background_stage_contrasts <-
  purrr::map_dfr(
    model_results,
    extract_background_stage_contrasts
  ) |>
  dplyr::group_by(
    background,
    processing_stage
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    p_value_fdr = stats::p.adjust(
      p.value,
      method = "BH"
    )
  ) |>

afis_background_stage_contrasts
```

# 20. Processing-stage contrasts within qTL status

```{r stage-contrasts-within-qtl}
extract_stage_contrasts <- function(
  result
) {

  if (
    inherits(
      result$model,
      "afis_model_error"
    )
  ) {
    return(
      tibble::tibble()
    )
  }

  stage_emmeans <- emmeans::emmeans(
    result$model,
    specs =
      ~ processing_stage |
        qtl_status
  )

  emmeans::contrast(
    stage_emmeans,
    method = "pairwise",
    by = "qtl_status",
    adjust = "tukey"
  ) |>
    as.data.frame() |>
    tibble::as_tibble() |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      trait_label = result$trait,
      .before = 1
    )
}

afis_stage_contrasts <- purrr::map_dfr(
  model_results,
  extract_stage_contrasts
)

afis_stage_contrasts
```

```{r key-test-summary}
key_effects <- c(

afis_key_test_summary <- afis_type3_tests |>

    ),
    names_glue = "{effect}_{.value}"
  )
```

# 22. Model diagnostics
```{r model-diagnostics}
extract_diagnostics <- function(
  result
) {

  if (
    inherits(
      result$model,
      "afis_model_error"
    )
  ) {
    return(
      tibble::tibble()
    )
  }

  model_data <- result$data

  model_residuals <- stats::residuals(
    result$model
  )

  model_fitted <- stats::fitted(
    result$model
  )

  model_data |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      observation = dplyr::row_number(),

      fitted_value = as.numeric(
        model_fitted
      ),

      residual = as.numeric(
        model_residuals
      ),

      standardized_residual =
        as.numeric(
          scale(
            model_residuals
          )
        )
    ) |>
    dplyr::select(
      trait_label,
      observation,
      field_sample_id,
      genotype,
      background,
      pair_id,
      qtl_status,
      field_rep,
      processing_stage,
      value,
      fitted_value,
      residual,
      standardized_residual
    )
}

afis_diagnostics <- purrr::map_dfr(
  model_results,
  extract_diagnostics
)

diagnostic_summary <- afis_diagnostics |>
  dplyr::group_by(
    trait_label
  ) |>
  dplyr::summarise(

    residual_mean = mean(
      residual,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    residual_sd = stats::sd(
      residual,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    maximum_absolute_standardized_residual =
      max(
        abs(
          standardized_residual
        ),
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),

    observations_above_three_sd = sum(
      abs(
        standardized_residual
      ) > 3,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    .groups = "drop"
  )

diagnostic_summary
```
```{r identify-residual-outliers}
afis_residual_outliers <- afis_diagnostics |>
  dplyr::filter(
    abs(
      standardized_residual
    ) > 3
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    absolute_standardized_residual =
      abs(
        standardized_residual
      )
  ) |>
  dplyr::arrange(
    dplyr::desc(
      absolute_standardized_residual
    )
  )

afis_residual_outliers
```

# 23. Nep_count sensitivity analysis

The primary `Nep_count` model is retained as part of the common 13-trait
analysis. Because its `pair_id` random-effect variance was estimated as zero,
a simplified sensitivity model is fitted without `(1 | pair_id)` to verify
that the biological conclusions are unchanged.

```{r refit-nep-count-sensitivity}
nep_count_data <- afis_model_data |>
  dplyr::filter(
    as.character(trait_label) == "Nep_count"
  ) |>
  droplevels()

nep_count_model_simplified <- lmerTest::lmer(
  value ~
    background * qtl_status * processing_stage +
    field_rep +
    (1 | field_sample_id),
  data = nep_count_data,
  REML = TRUE,
  na.action = stats::na.omit,
  control = lme4::lmerControl(
    optimizer = "bobyqa",
    optCtrl = list(
      maxfun = 200000
    )
  )
)

nep_count_sensitivity_singular <- lme4::isSingular(
  nep_count_model_simplified,
  tol = 1e-4
)

summary(
  nep_count_model_simplified
)

nep_count_sensitivity_singular
```

```{r nep-count-type3-sensitivity}
nep_count_type3_raw <- stats::anova(
  nep_count_model_simplified,
  type = 3,
  ddf = "Satterthwaite"
) |>
  as.data.frame() |>
  tibble::rownames_to_column(
    var = "effect"
  ) |>
  tibble::as_tibble()

nep_count_p_column <- grep(
  "^Pr\\(",
  names(nep_count_type3_raw),
  value = TRUE
)[1]

if (
  length(nep_count_p_column) == 0 ||
  is.na(nep_count_p_column)
) {
  stop(
    "The p-value column could not be identified for the ",
    "simplified Nep_count model."
  )
}

nep_count_type3_simplified <- tibble::tibble(
  effect = nep_count_type3_raw$effect,
  numerator_df = nep_count_type3_raw[["NumDF"]],
  denominator_df = nep_count_type3_raw[["DenDF"]],
  f_value = nep_count_type3_raw[["F value"]],
  p_value = nep_count_type3_raw[[nep_count_p_column]]
)

nep_count_type3_simplified
```

```{r nep-count-stage-contrasts-sensitivity}
nep_count_emmeans <- emmeans::emmeans(
  nep_count_model_simplified,
  specs = ~ qtl_status | processing_stage
)

nep_count_stage_contrasts_simplified <- emmeans::contrast(
  nep_count_emmeans,
  method = list(
    "Positive - Negative" = c(
      -1,
      1
    )
  ),
  by = "processing_stage",
  adjust = "none"
) |>
  as.data.frame() |>
  tibble::as_tibble()

nep_count_stage_contrasts_simplified
```

# 24. Diagnostic plots

```{r save-diagnostic-plots}
plot_diagnostics <- function(
  trait_name
) {

  plot_data <- afis_diagnostics |>
    dplyr::filter(
      trait_label == trait_name
    )

  residual_plot <- ggplot2::ggplot(
    plot_data,
    ggplot2::aes(
      x = fitted_value,
      y = residual
    )
  ) +
    ggplot2::geom_point(
      alpha = 0.65
    ) +
    ggplot2::geom_hline(
      yintercept = 0,
      linetype = 2
    ) +
    ggplot2::labs(
      title = paste(
        trait_name,
        "Residuals versus fitted values"
      ),
      x = "Fitted value",
      y = "Residual"
    ) +
    ggplot2::theme_bw()

  qq_plot <- ggplot2::ggplot(
    plot_data,
    ggplot2::aes(
      sample = residual
    )
  ) +
    ggplot2::stat_qq() +
    ggplot2::stat_qq_line() +
    ggplot2::labs(
      title = paste(
        trait_name,
        "Normal Q-Q plot"
      ),
      x = "Theoretical quantile",
      y = "Observed residual quantile"
    ) +
    ggplot2::theme_bw()

  ggplot2::ggsave(
    filename = file.path(
      analysis_diagnostics,
      paste0(
        trait_name,
        "_residuals_vs_fitted.png"
      )
    ),
    plot = residual_plot,
    width = 8,
    height = 6,
    dpi = 300
  )

  ggplot2::ggsave(
    filename = file.path(
      analysis_diagnostics,
      paste0(
        trait_name,
        "_qq_plot.png"
      )
    ),
    plot = qq_plot,
    width = 8,
    height = 6,
    dpi = 300
  )
}

purrr::walk(
  trait_names[
    trait_names %in%
      unique(
        afis_diagnostics$trait_label
      )
  ],
  plot_diagnostics
)
```

# 25. Estimated-mean plots

```{r create-estimated-mean-plots}
plot_emmeans <- function(
  trait_name
) {

  plot_data <- afis_emmeans |>
    dplyr::filter(
      trait_label == trait_name
    )

  trait_plot <- ggplot2::ggplot(
    plot_data,
    ggplot2::aes(
      x = processing_stage,
      y = emmean,
      group = qtl_status,
      shape = qtl_status,
      linetype = qtl_status
    )
  ) +
    ggplot2::geom_line(
      linewidth = 0.8
    ) +
    ggplot2::geom_point(
      size = 2.8
    ) +
    ggplot2::geom_errorbar(
      ggplot2::aes(
        ymin = lower.CL,
        ymax = upper.CL
      ),
      width = 0.08
    ) +
    ggplot2::labs(
      title = trait_name,
      subtitle =
        "Estimated marginal means across processing stages",
      x = "Processing stage",
      y = "Estimated marginal mean",
      shape = "qFL-Chr.25 status",
      linetype = "qFL-Chr.25 status"
    ) +
    ggplot2::theme_bw() +
    ggplot2::theme(
      legend.position = "top"
    )

  ggplot2::ggsave(
    filename = file.path(
      analysis_figures,
      paste0(
        trait_name,
        "_estimated_means.png"
      )
    ),
    plot = trait_plot,
    width = 8.5,
    height = 6,
    dpi = 300
  )

  trait_plot
}
```

```{r display-example-plot}
plot_emmeans(
  trait_names[1]
)
```

```{r save-all-estimated-mean-plots}
purrr::walk(
  trait_names[

      unique(

      plot_emmeans(x)

)
```

```{r save-model-objects}
successful_models <- purrr::map(
  model_results,
  function(result) {

    if (
      inherits(
        result$model,
        "afis_model_error"
      )
    ) {
      return(NULL)
    }

    result$model
  }
)

successful_models <- successful_models[
  !vapply(
    successful_models,
    is.null,
    logical(1)
  )
]

saveRDS(

    analysis_models,

)
```
